rows.text: Incoming inspection commission assigned by order: NIKIMT-Atomstroy JSC No 39-300/23-P Dated: 30-05-2022
The Commission have issued this Incoming Inspection Certificate of Materials for the Materials as follows:
Type, brand, standard (technical requirement, GOST, etc.)
Waterproofing polymer material TechnoNikol LOGICBASE V-SL, 3.0 mm
LOGICBASE V-strip FB 1,3 мм TECHNONIKOL tape
Extrusion polystyrene polystyrene XPS Carbon PROF 1180x580x100 mm TECHNONICOL
Name and number of the document that certifies quality:
2. As a result of inspection were revealed following:

2.1 Remarks for accompanying documents (none, or give comments): 1) Provided scans for Waterproofing polymeric material TechnoNikol LOGICBASE V-SL, 3,0 mm with lots 81209, 81234, 81233, 81232 and document numbers 8904, 9126, 9125, 9113 respectively. Provide original documents.2) Provide scans for TECHNONICOL EU-320-4 gydraulic gasket with lots 62014, 61898 and document numbers 9133, 4504 respectively. Provide original documents.3) Provide scans for TECHNICOL V-ST 3mm Protective membrane with lots 80882, 81177 and document numbers 2731, 5548 respectively for actual delivery. Provide original documents.4) The document for the Fastening element Fastener TECHNONICOL No. 01 with lot 10 was not provided.5) Scan document for LOGICBASE V-strip FB 1,3 mm TECHNONICOL tape with lot 62002 and number 9014 was provided. There is no document for the delivered products with lot 61923. Provide original documents.6) Scans of documents for Technonikol 500 g/m2 nonwoven geotextile material with lots 302400, 302531. To provide original documents.7) Scans of documents for Technonikol 600 ml swelling sealant with lot *563. Provide original documents.8) Scans of documents for TECHNICOL IC-SP swellable polymer profile from batch 96/23, actual delivery from batch 98/23. Documents for the actual delivery were not provided. Provide original documents.9) In English translations of documents for Extrusion polystyrene foam XPS Carbon PROF 1180x580x100 mm TECHNONICOL the batch size is not specified. Provide original documents.Staff the document scans appropriately.
2.2. Remarks for visual, measurement and other inspections including Material’s completeness (none, or give comments): NONE
2.3. Remarks for preservation and/or anticorrosive coating (none, or give comments): NONE
2.4. Non-conformities (none, or give comments, Non-conformity report no.): NONE
